summary: Every Reaction taken in a battle follows the Rules of Presence and Location (R-089): the player needs a unit at the battlefield, a Reaction on a Personality/attachment needs it there (Engage movers, Tsukimi/Rokku/Wave Persists self-moves and Mitsuo exempt), Holdings and hand Strategies need only player presence, Regions only at their own battle province; presence is kept until the window opened by a destruction closes. Fixtures in 35 tests updated.
validation: dotnet L5R.Core.Tests full run 0 failures; tools/check.sh --skip-client passed; new ReactionNeedsPresence test
remaining: Quagmire (names an adjacent province) now reacts only at its own battle province and its window still opens for adjacent regions (RegionIsNear); no native client check; Lookout tests now place the Ninja at the battlefield.
